steps.en: Company IDs are told apart from individuals
steps.why_en: The company ID comes from a reminder letter, not a court summons.
steps.why_id: ID perusahaan berasal dari surat reminder, bukan court summons.

steps.en: UEN is sent to the company registry
steps.why_en: The company lookup exists but is switched off in the prod settings.
steps.why_id: Pencarian perusahaan ada tetapi dimatikan di setting prod.

steps.en: The latest company address is received and kept
steps.id: Alamat perusahaan terbaru diterima dan disimpan
steps.why_en: It is kept in a temporary place only, and only when the job runs.
steps.why_id: Hanya disimpan sementara, dan hanya bila job berjalan.

steps.en: The system decides whether the address changed
steps.why_en: No comparison; staff only read a report.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada perbandingan; staff hanya membaca report.
